scope: Independent read-only source/requirement reconciliation; no player code, fixture/native runner, observed GUI, provider, release, or ownership changes.
review_method: Twelve read-only textual predicates evaluated against the exact current and historical blobs; no Lua, Python host, Factorio-native or GUI process executed.

source_predicates.scope: presence/order/parentage/layout-loop/callback source text only; cannot prove native rendering

findings.fact: Both versions declare research, queue, settings, help in that order; names alone do not establish geometry.
MIR4 renderer creates title before one tabbed-pane and attaches four flow pages using add_tab.
MIR5 create_frame creates its title before create_tabs and creates one tabbed-pane with four scroll-pane pages.
MIR5 Research search/filter widgets are children of research_page, not siblings of the tabbed-pane. This is a structural correction of the moving-navigation class.
sync_frame_layout applies identical viewport width/height to every tab page, while the Research content area alone subtracts its filter budget.
Selected-tab callback only updates view.tab and invokes render; it neither directly modifies geometry nor destroys the frame.
Library sizing uses resolution, scale and saved geometry; tab_content_height(frame_height) uses one shared frame-height budget; split_sizes has a narrow stacked fallback.

Current render can still discard/rebuild a frame when frame_layout_ready fails, and sync_frame_layout can rebuild tabbed-pane if Research filters fail readiness. Stable source structure alone does not prove rendered retention across all lifecycle paths.

qualification_matrix.inputs: Exact chosen candidate ZIP, one real Factorio GUI client, fixed display resolution/scale/geometry; EN
qualification_matrix.actions: Open Research; capture tabs/frame rectangle; click Queue -> Settings -> Help -> Research; capture same rectangles after each click
qualification_matrix.oracle: Title and four-tab navigation remain in the same pixel location and same size; no tab-dependent frame resize, no unexpected content overlap or loss of click target

qualification_matrix.inputs: Same candidate and geometry, DE with long localized labels
qualification_matrix.actions: Repeat all four tabs plus one Search/dropdown interaction and scroll in Research
qualification_matrix.oracle: Fixed navigation geometry; long labels wrap or clip only within owned panes, never relocate the tabs or obscure controls

qualification_matrix.inputs: At least 1280x720 and 2560x1440 physical resolution; include scale 1.0 and one >1.0; same candidate
qualification_matrix.actions: Repeat tab navigation at each fixed display configuration; separately resize the frame across split/stacked boundary
qualification_matrix.oracle: No movement when only tab changes; intentional layout changes only upon explicit geometry change, with valid list/detail and readable controls

qualification_matrix.inputs: Research selection/scroll, Settings query and personal filters before cross-tab visit
qualification_matrix.actions: Switch tabs and return, close/reopen; save, reload and perform cold-load lifecycle where applicable
qualification_matrix.oracle: Selected research and owned personal state retained per documented contract; native queue/research and other players' state unmodified; no unsupported authority introduced

qualification_matrix.inputs: Published 5.0.13 observers 0.3.12/0.4.6 only as historical separate inputs; require exact later candidate binding
qualification_matrix.actions: Inspect observer/candidate version pin, native mouse/keyboard focus, tab rectangles and screenshots
qualification_matrix.oracle: A 5.0.13 observer cannot be relabeled 5.0.14; controller screenshots and actual input receipt both required, no inferred GUI pass from scripted dispatch

qualification_matrix.inputs: Actual accepted MIR4 visual reference and exact new package visual output
qualification_matrix.actions: Compare titlebar, tab strip, result/detail proportions, science/effect details, settings grouping and export access with approved MIR4 design
qualification_matrix.oracle: Retain MIR4 usable hierarchy and split/detail behavior rather than merely matching tab names; document deliberate differences and actual visual evidence

separate_accepted_evidence.historical_mir4: Retained v4.7.3 reference capture and one bounded EN native retained-details run are separately recorded by library-authored-layout-native-r01; they do not prove current release UI.
separate_accepted_evidence.prior_negative: Old published 5.0.0 split-layout negative and later source-host positive are retained in library-cont10-layout-negative-control-r01; they are not input/pixel passes.
separate_accepted_evidence.current_candidate: At inspection, latest delivered public packages are 5.0.13 beta; 5.0.14 is not qualified or delivered by this review.

explicit_nonclaims: No actual fixed-tab pixel geometry or user-input behavior has been observed for current 5.0.13 or candidate 5.0.14.
No EN/DE two-client, resizing, search, export, persistence, accessibility, performance or stable result follows from textual structure.
Existing MIR4 design parity, native input/export/client lifecycle and whole-product performance remain open.
No inference of stable readiness, no replay of previously accepted work, and no change to the existing worker/native owners.
next_admission: Owner of the later selected exact candidate must freeze input/pixel observer and controlled display before native tab-geometry qualification; compare evidence to this independent oracle without changing accepted historical inputs.
